title: Ray Serve: Concurrency issue with llm_serve_telemetry actor
description:
What happened + What you expected to happen
The Bug
When starting a ray serve application with
serve run --blocking --address $IP_HEAD $serve_config > my_log.log 2>&1 &
I sometimes run in the error ValueError: Actor with name 'llm_serve_telemetry' already exists in the namespace llm_serve_telemetry. My guess is due to concurrently starting models, two models see there is no llm_serve_telemetry actor and both attempt to create one. As one is faster, the other raises this error. Could that be?

The deployment crashed and has to be restarted.

Expected Behavior
All initial replicas of a model can be started in parallel.

Useful Information

ray serve config:

http_options: 
  port: 8001
logging_config:
  enable_access_log: false
  log_level: "WARNING"
applications:
- name: augment_ray_serve_app
  import_path: ray.serve.llm:build_openai_app
  route_prefix: "/"
  args:
    llm_configs:
      - model_loading_config:
          model_id: "augmenter"
          model_source: "Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B"
        deployment_config:
          autoscaling_config:
            target_ongoing_requests: 2
            upscale_delay_s: 2
            downscale_delay_s: 600
            initial_replicas: 14 # 28 GPUs
            min_replicas: 1
            max_replicas: 16 # 32 GPUs
        runtime_env:
          env_vars:
            VLLM_USE_V1: "1"
        engine_kwargs:
          tensor_parallel_size: 2
          pipeline_parallel_size: 1
          gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9
          dtype: "auto"
          max_num_seqs: 40
          max_model_len: 16384 # no yarn max:  32768, 16384, 8192, 
          enable_chunked_prefill: true
          enable_prefix_caching: true
          trust_remote_code: true
          tokenizer: "/work_dir/pipeline/src/datadistill/explore/qwen3"
      - model_loading_config:
          model_id: "web_search_simulator"
          model_source: "Alibaba-NLP/Simulation_LLM_google_14B_V2"
        deployment_config:
          autoscaling_config:
            target_ongoing_requests: 2
            upscale_delay_s: 2
            downscale_delay_s: 600
            initial_replicas: 4 # 4 GPUs
            min_replicas: 1
            max_replicas: 32 # 32 GPUs
        engine_kwargs:
          tensor_parallel_size: 1
          pipeline_parallel_size: 1
          gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9
          dtype: "auto"
          max_num_seqs: 40
          max_model_len: 32768
          enable_chunked_prefill: true
          enable_prefix_caching: true
          trust_remote_code: true
- name: wiki_search_app
  import_path: wikipedia.server:app_builder 
  route_prefix: /wiki
  deployments:
    - name: "WikiSearchDeployment"
      ray_actor_options:
        num_cpu: 1
        # while with 0.5 it works (only a few MiB are taken), it blocks an entire GPU, as build_openai_app above
        # does not support fractional GPUs
        num_gpus: 0
